rules.title: SQL Injection Prevention
rules.check: NEVER concatenate strings into SQL queries. MUST use parameterized queries or EF Core LINQ methods.
rules.bad_example:
var query = "SELECT * FROM Users WHERE Name = '" + name + "'";
// Attacker sends: "' OR '1'='1"

rules.title: No Hardcoded Secrets
rules.check: NEVER commit API keys, connection strings, or passwords to source control. Use IConfiguration or Key Vault.

rules.title: Controller Input Validation
rules.check: Public API endpoints MUST validate all inputs. Prefer FluentValidation or DataAnnotations.

rules.title: Secure Deserialization
rules.check: Do not use BinaryFormatter or insecure serializers on untrusted data. Use System.Text.Json.

rules.title: CSRF Protection
rules.check: Anti-forgery tokens MUST be validated on all state-changing endpoints.

rules.title: Path Traversal Prevention
rules.check: File paths from user input MUST be sanitized. Path.Combine with user input is dangerous.
rules.bad_example:
var path = Path.Combine(_uploadDir, userFileName);
// User sends "../../../etc/passwd"

rules.title: Cryptography Standards
rules.check: Use secure cryptographic primitives. MD5/SHA1 are forbidden for security purposes. Use RandomNumberGenerator not Random.
rules.good_example:
var token = Convert.ToBase64String(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32));

var hash = SHA256.HashData(data); // Or SHA384/SHA512

rules.title: Authorization on Endpoints
rules.check: All endpoints MUST have explicit authorization attributes. Implicit allow is forbidden.

rules.title: Security Headers
rules.check: Responses MUST include security headers to prevent common attacks.

rules.title: CORS Configuration
rules.check: CORS policies MUST be explicit. AllowAnyOrigin with credentials is forbidden.
rules.bad_example:
builder.Services.AddCors(o => o.AddPolicy("Bad", p =>
    p.AllowAnyOrigin()
     .AllowAnyHeader()
     .AllowCredentials())); // Security vulnerability!

rules.title: Options Pattern Validation
rules.check: Configuration options MUST use ValidateDataAnnotations() and ValidateOnStart().
rules.rationale: Fail-fast on startup prevents runtime errors from missing or invalid configuration.

rules.title: Environment Variables for Secrets
rules.check: Secrets in Docker environments MUST use environment variables, NOT appsettings files.
rules.bad_example:
COPY appsettings.Production.json /app/
# Secrets baked into image
rules.rationale: Environment variables are injected at runtime and don't persist in images or source control.

rules.title: Refit Client Security
rules.check: Refit clients MUST configure authentication headers via DelegatingHandler, NOT inline.
rules.rationale: Centralized auth handling ensures consistent security and enables token refresh logic.
